sources.note: Main website. TRIARQ is a national MSO partnering with independent specialty providers. Mentions QSuite, MyQOne portal, TRIARQ Clouds. Serves orthopedics, urology, oncology, cardiology, neurology.

Technology page describing QSuite components: EMR, Practice Management, QInsights analytics, QIntake patient registration, Patient Portal, cloud hosting on GCP. Also describes QComplete full-service RCM bundle.
About page listing leadership team (5 executives). Certifications: BDO 2021, Surescripts 2020, ONC certified, SLI Compliance. No customer count or founding date disclosed.

Urology-specific page. Lists QSuite modules: QPM, QIntake, QInsights, QScribe (AI ambient note generation), QPathways (referral networks), QComplete (RCM). Details care coordination, authorization management, denial prevention.
Orthopedics-specific page. Same QSuite module lineup. Describes 'orthopedic-built EHR' and end-to-end RCM. Mentions value-based care support via QPathways.

General specialty practice management page. Describes QPM features: scheduling (including telehealth), intake, automated insurance/eligibility verification, prior authorizations, real-time dashboards. Serves orthopedics, oncology, urology.
RCM page. Describes claims management, A/R management (auto-flagging denied/underpaid claims), financial reporting dashboards, workflow automation, prior auth, patient payment tools.

Blog post about TRIARQ's comprehensive MSO model. Details 7 service areas: staffing, technology (QSuite), compliance, medical billing, insurance relations, supply chain, real estate. QSuite features: e-prescribing, flexible note-taking, billing tools, patient portals, customizable reporting, monthly scorecards.
ONC mandatory disclosure PDF from 2017. Could not parse content (PDF rendered as binary). Linked from CHPL metadata.

SoftwareFinder listing. One review (4/5): 'good EMR with potential to improve.' Lists target users including ambulatory surgery centers and diagnostic providers. Notes custom pricing. Mentions limitations: implementation time investment, limited MIPS filing options.

FindEMR listing. Features: patient portals, appointment scheduling, e-prescriptions, billing tools, reporting/analytics, lab integration, compliance tracking, claims management. Surescripts and ONC-certified. Serves neurosurgery, pediatrics, orthopedics, urology.
Capterra listing (403 error on fetch, info from search snippet). User review mentions 10+ years with product, praising functionality and ease of use. Trainers can get users up to speed quickly.
